https.methodology: Fresh disposable profiles, public one-page article, real app and pinned assets, 2 MiB initial prefix then socket reset. HTTPS/H2 use a fresh one-day self-signed localhost certificate with validation disabled only in the disposable test browser. The H2 fault closes the TLS socket to simulate a connection loss. Throughput includes verification/compilation time and is not an internet speed benchmark. A still-transferring outcome is not a passing recovery acceptance check.
